items.title: Rules Governing AFL-CIO Local Central Bodies (pamphlet)
items.description: AFL-CIO Publication No. 13, the national rules for local central bodies (labor councils), photographed as a booklet from the cover through pages 12–13. The rules cover charters, delegates, officers, strikes, boycotts, and labor publications. The Labor Coalition used these rules when it rewrote its constitution to affiliate with the AFL-CIO.
items.notes: This 1973 edition was filed with the Coalition's 1993–94 affiliation papers. Photographed back-to-front; shown here in reading order. Pages 12–13 were photographed twice.

items.description: A draft agreement for joint work: expanding The Working Press to Steuben, combining political action across congressional and state districts, solidarity support, extending Midstate's health and safety program, and exploring a shared staff position. items.title: Photographs: an outdoor labor gathering with Hinchey campaign signs
items.description: Six color prints from an outdoor gathering on a lawn: musicians playing (one with a “Hinchey” sign), a man speaking at a microphone, a crowd under trees, people at picnic tables, and a food table. The back of one print carries a handwritten thank-you: “Carl & Robin — Thanks for all your help on the Ramada. You were your usual wonderful selves! — Al.”
items.notes: Maurice Hinchey represented the area in Congress from 1993 to 2013; the signs suggest a date in the 1990s, but event, place, and date are not identified on the prints. The picnic print appears twice. If you recognize this gathering, please get in touch.
